name: Songkran
summary: Thai New Year water festival, biggest in Chiang Mai.
details: Nationwide water fights and temple visits for the Thai New Year. Chiang Mai has the largest street celebrations.

name: Loy Krathong and Yi Peng
when: full moon of the 12th lunar month, usually November
summary: Floating lanterns and krathong boats, Chiang Mai.
details: Lanterns released into the sky and krathong floated on water at the November full moon.

name: Awa Odori
summary: Japan's largest dance festival, in Tokushima.
details: Dance groups parade through Tokushima over four nights during Obon.

name: Gion Matsuri
when: the whole of July, floats on 17 and 24 July
summary: Kyoto's month-long summer festival with float processions.

name: Sapporo Snow Festival
summary: Snow and ice sculptures in Odori Park.

name: Harbin Ice and Snow Festival
summary: Large ice sculptures and lit snow parks, deep winter.

name: Comiket
when: twice a year, August and late December
summary: Giant self-published comics convention at Tokyo Big Sight.
crowd: Hundreds of thousands of visitors over the event days; nearby trains and hotels are very busy.
price: Hotels near Tokyo Big Sight rise.

name: Autumn leaves (momiji), Kyoto
summary: Peak autumn colour in Kyoto's temples and gardens.
details: Timing shifts by a week or two each year and by altitude.
crowd: Among the busiest times of the year.
price: Highest hotel prices of the year in Kyoto.

name: Cherry blossom (sakura), Tokyo
summary: Cherry blossom viewing parties in parks and along rivers.

name: Silver grass festival, Haneul Park
summary: Fields of silver grass in Haneul Park, Seoul, in autumn.

name: Chuseok
when: three days around the autumn full moon, September or October
summary: Korean harvest holiday with many events and festivals.
perk: Free entrance to the palaces and to many events and festivals.

name: Golden Week
details: Often described as busy, but little effect has been noticed in practice.
